evidence.claim: Baseline v0.44 supports plain directory workspaces, editable exclusions, hierarchical gitignore and in-place Git adoption while preserving isolation and history.
CLI reports controlled service build metadata and recovery diagnostics, sends ordinary RPC directly and retains existing request/outcome semantics.

Loopback service preserves authenticated admission and recovery boundaries; browser login reports missing sessions, expired codes and invalid/used codes, and checking a valid session does not rotate or extend it.
Runtime reuses archived resources across workspace adapter changes and invalidates current freshness; ordinary browsing keeps the existing no-full-scan boundary.
Workspace registry locates nearest directory/Git boundaries, keeps stable UUIDs across atomic Git adoption and rejects identity or path conflicts without Git downgrade.
Model validation checks evidence-list syntax before resolving IDs and gives declared-relationship DSL guidance while preserving identity and reference constraints.
Task bindings and archived selections remain immutable; routing advises directory backups or Git versioning according to actual workspace type.
Actual skill files and references are scanned, versioned and captured as editable file content.
File-authoritative Archive supports bounded stable-ID/header and sequence queries; recovery and requested reference integrity remain checked.
SearchIndex sends typed operations to a separate SQLite worker and supports derived projection rebuilding.
Git and filesystem adapters share byte/link capture; directory scans use hierarchical ignore rules and two enumerations plus byte checks, preserving unknown on failures.
Freshness uses directory scan rules for new path classification and invalidates proofs for identity, rule and byte changes while preserving strict epochs and evidence scope.
ObservationManager restores explicit log bindings and checkpoint/events from the file archive.
Ordinary legacy discovery uses the owning verified archive and ordered commit metadata; explicit migration/requested legacy bytes and conservative GC retain existing checks and protected content.
Web labels actual directory workspaces and retains task, canvas, skill, structure and historical interactions.

Web confirms browser cookies before clearing successful sign-in credentials, retains the original URL on transient failures, clears explicitly rejected credentials with targets preserved, and keeps actual HTTP 401 reasons.

English entry requires an actual available and permitted native question-tool call for required decisions, one question at a time, explicit waiting; per-turn routing and authorization reuse remain. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries.
Bundled methods are self-contained within each selected folder; editable user files and archived bytes retain their existing boundaries.

Formal CLI builds stamp provenance and ship explicit skill-installation and runtime-verification tools; prototype scripts remain separate. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries.
Frozen v0.16 prototype and MGRP examples remain historical/reference material separate from the formal implementation.

Text authority and reference lifecycle remain; known uses exact retained bodies from the same task and cannot replace the first read with another task hash. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries.

Controller distinguishes live startup ownership from stopped/authenticated endpoints, joins bounded startup without spawning a competitor, sanitizes optional build metadata and preserves pre-execution-only RPC retries.
Web documentation describes visible-history restoration beyond the first page, error fallback and non-current model snapshot labels.
Layout counts every node of each omitted subtree with a temporary stack, keeps visible hit paths and synthetic body leaves out of overflow counts, and preserves bounded disclosure and input trees.
Skill layout preserves saved selection identities and groups, aggregates unselected catalog members and folders, and omits unselected file nodes.
Standalone context and skill directories provide scoped search, hit filtering and 50-row paging with explicit inspection and candidate actions.
Batch read-only Git classification distinguishes tracked, untracked, ignored and unknown local document evidence without staging or changing source exclusions.

Source batching preserves raw/current-state checks and link boundaries; explicit evidence references and scoped synchronization retain existing physical-path, anomaly and pending/history rules. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries.

Storage preserves original journals and snapshots; new freshness rows reference receipt state bytes, and compact derived indexes catch up continuous commits. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries.
Default methods link only to their own archived attachments; user related candidates remain optional and historical bytes remain immutable.

Runtime guidance uses discovered installed contract paths, guards failure envelopes and requires explicit scope decisions and new reviewed declarations after sync conflicts. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries.

A conservative display-only predicate marks suspected damaged reasons without changing archived input.
Skill details show a suspected encoding warning and expose the exact saved reason on demand.
